account.dd_definition: Native maximum equity drawdown amount and native maximum relative equity drawdown percent; their peaks may differ.
account.cost_definition: Commission+swap+fees from matched full lifecycles, divided by opening standard lots. Actual bid/ask spread is already in net and is not subtracted again. This is recorded explicit cost, not an independently estimated spread/slippage total.
